subject: HOF Gen6 diagnostics blocker: Transition Lab misattributes false-90 semantic transition; measured 120Hz request remains 60Hz
body: Completed a non-duplicative diagnostics-integrity lane against rechecked main 699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2. FIELD: the false PUBLIC_STANDARD coarse 90 is accepted at uptime 133874615 and drives NATIVE_COVER->OPENING_FROM_CLOSED 1ms later. Transition Lab observes that 90 as hinge seq7931/event51297, yet state-transition event51298 references stale seq7930 SYNTHETIC_ENDPOINT 0deg from 2349ms earlier; INNER_HANDOFF event51339 repeats it at 2749ms age. Replay finds 2/41 state-transition attribution mismatches, exactly this P0 chain. SOURCE: TransitionLab independently suppresses public latestHingeSample while Samsung is considered fresh for 3.0s (SAMSUNG_AUTHORITY_WINDOW_NS), but production Fold7AngleAuthority precise ownership expires after 192ms; lab therefore diverges from real semantic authority for up to ~2.808s. Fold7HingeIngressBatch also strips source/coarse/reason metadata before main-thread reduction, forcing heuristic correlation. Required invariant: production authority identity/sequence must be propagated through ingress and referenced directly by hinge-driven state-transition events; observational sensor probes must not decide semantic attribution. FIELD 120Hz: two request windows measured ~59.935Hz and ~59.943Hz median FrameTimeline cadence; Gen6 opening had 0/68 120Hz-like intervals despite request=120 and supported modes. Add lease request/confirmed-or-not-honored/release telemetry using measured cadence, not immediate Display.mode alone. Deterministic validator accepts raw ZIP or extracted bundle and currently exits 2 as expected. No production writes. Coarse90 policy and terminal fence remain owned by dedicated lanes; stale generation42 post-terminal evidence is only supporting corroboration here.
